biotools.summary: pyPCG is a Python toolbox for phonocardiography analysis, providing functions for processing, segmentation, feature extraction, and statistical analysis of heart sounds. It aims to serve as a basis for a standard framework for heart sound analysis and offers improved segmentation compared to other available methods.
